units: Y. Ned. I, end, 37ᵃ כקדושת כ׳ as sacred as the Biblical writings.—Esp. כְּתוּבֵי the Hagiographa.—

<cite ref="Taanit 9a:6">Taan. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>מי איכא מידי דכתיבא בכ׳ וכ׳</he> is there anything written in the Hagiographa that is not intimated in the Law? <cite ref="Bava Batra 8a:2">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>עברת אדאורייתא ואדכ׳ …</he> thou didst act against what is written in the Law, the Prophets and the Hagiographa.
<cite ref="Ketubot 106b:3">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>דאקרייך כ׳ לא וכ׳</he> he who taught thee the Hagiographa has not taught thee the Prophets; a. e.
